diagnostics.message:
[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The Karpenter Provisioner manifest sets providerRef.name to "default", matching the AWSNodeTemplate created by node_template, but there is no dependency edge between them. Terraform may apply the Provisioner before its referenced template exists; order the template manifest first.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The Karpenter Provisioner names the AWSNodeTemplate `default` in `providerRef`, but its `yaml_body` has no reference to the node-template resource. Terraform can therefore create the Provisioner before the referenced template exists; make the Provisioner depend on the node-template resource.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The Provisioner manifest references the AWSNodeTemplate named `default` through `providerRef`, but Terraform has no dependency ordering it after the node-template manifest. Create the template before applying the Provisioner so the referenced provider object is available.
